model_figure.caption_latex: Q-LACE pipeline. Report-derived weak supervision adapts a medical VLM for held-out finding-conditioned interval-change classification using 2,048 weak-training examples per run. Adaptation includes language/vision LoRA and trainable input embeddings and output head; other base weights remain frozen. Historical validation-monitoring schedules are specified in Appendix~\ref{sec:historical_provenance}. ``No evidence'' is an appendix diagnostic, while the three change labels define the benchmark task. The illustrative radiographs are separate NIH Clinical Center images from different patients, arranged to depict input roles; they are not a real longitudinal pair or study evaluation case. NIH credit and download: \url{https://nihcc.app.box.com/v/ChestXray-NIHCC}; \cite{wang2017chestxray}. Author-created schematic, exported with Inkscape 1.4.4/cairo 1.18.4.

tables.caption_latex: Historical synthetic hard-negative training diagnostics. Candidate NSE (\texttt{no\_supported\_evidence}) rows are not adjudicated negatives. Benchmark rows have supported labels, so NSE outputs there are false abstentions. Ratio variants mix synthetic NSE rows into the 4,096-row weak recipe; balanced and natural variants use more aggressive base rates. The 2\% variant never abstains, higher rates trade supported-task performance for abstention, and the natural variant collapses to always abstain. These are separate single-run diagnostics.
